#!/usr/bin/env bash
# usage: ./fwd.sh   or  install as systemd service
set -euo pipefail

while true; do
  echo "[$(date -Is)] forwarding :{{local_port}} -> {{remote_host}}:{{remote_port}}"
  socat -d TCP-LISTEN:{{local_port}},reuseaddr,fork \
        TCP:{{remote_host}}:{{remote_port}} || true
  echo "socat exited, restart in 3s"; sleep 3
done
